name: pinned-leftover-first-screen-moves
rationale: Both data-hardware routes buried their first meaningful interactive behind a motion scene: data-bottleneck reached DataScaleChart after 389 preceding words and evaluation-crisis reached ReliabilityCompounding after 329, both over the 300-word and 1600px first-screen budget of VAL-EDU-045(a). Each article moves exactly one existing mount block above its scene; every sentence, claim, number, citation and the frontmatter are byte-preserved (the edits are pure block swaps, verified by identity of the sorted line inventory). The unchanged data-hardware motion continuity review still gates the prior endpoint and its full disclosure inventory before this successor applies.
